# SEO Landing Page Template

Use this template for route pages, stop pages, and rider guide pages.

## Frontmatter Template

```yaml
title: "Primary Intent | MBTA Tracker"
description: "Clear rider outcome + realtime context + trust qualifier."
slug: "mbta/routes/example"
canonical: "https://www.mbta-tracker.com/mbta/routes/example"
lastUpdated: "2026-07-05"
pageType: "route_page"
primaryKeyword: "example keyword"
secondaryKeywords:
  - "secondary keyword 1"
  - "secondary keyword 2"
```

## Page Structure

1. H1 with primary keyword and rider value.
2. 1-2 sentence answer block immediately under H1.
3. Realtime utility section (what the rider can do now).
4. Route or stop context section.
5. FAQ section with only truthful, verifiable answers.
6. Internal links to at least 3 related pages.
7. Last updated timestamp.

## Copy Guidance

- Write for real riders under time pressure.
- Keep first paragraph under 60 words.
- Avoid inflated claims.
- Keep paragraphs short and scan-friendly.

## On-Page SEO Checklist

- One H1 only.
- Include primary keyword in H1 and intro.
- Include primary keyword or variant in title and meta description.
- Add 2-4 secondary variants naturally.
- Include one concise list for snippet eligibility.

## FAQ Block Pattern

- What does this page help with?
- How recent are the arrivals shown?
- What should riders do if data looks stale?

## Internal Linking Pattern

At the bottom of each page include:

- Related route pages.
- Related stop pages.
- One practical rider guide.

## Structured Data Notes

- Keep JSON-LD aligned to visible page content.
- Do not add FAQ schema if the FAQ is not present on page.
- Do not claim ratings or reviews unless they exist.
